gloss: advance payment; prepaid expense; money paid up front

definitions.gloss: advance payment; prepaid expense; money paid up front
definitions.explanation: Money handed over before goods are delivered or services are performed. In accounting it is carried as an asset until the goods or services are actually received.

examples.japanese: {前払金|まえばらいきん}を{支払|しはら}った。
{契約時|けいやくじ}に{前払金|まえばらいきん}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: An advance payment is required when the contract is signed.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}の{前払金|まえばらいきん}は{総額|そうがく}の{三割|さんわり}と{決|き}まっている。
examples.english: The advance payment for the construction work is set at 30% of the total.

notes:
An accounting and business term for money paid ahead of delivery. It is the money itself, not the practice of paying early.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前払金|まえばらいきん}を{支払|しはら}う: to pay an advance
- {前払金|まえばらいきん}を{受|う}け{取|と}る: to receive an advance
- {前払金|まえばらいきん}の{返還|へんかん}: return of an advance payment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {前払|まえばら}い: advance payment — the act or arrangement of paying early
- {内金|うちきん}: part payment — a portion of the price paid first, with the balance to follow
- {手付金|てつけきん}: deposit — secures a contract and may be forfeited if the buyer backs out
